summary: All new declarations and files are documented, but several docstrings are inaccurate: a verbatim copy-paste onto the private uIcc wrapper describes only the boundedness half, the module docstring overclaims that this file reproves the avoiding case, a public docstring points readers at a private lemma with an example its own sibling contradicts, and one docstring references a variable that does not exist in the statement.
